claim: The verified R6 tick_trace contains 5977 instances where the recorder-emitted State string changes between two consecutive sampled rows for the same stable player_slot, spanning 105 distinct ordered State-string pairs.

evidence.observation: Deterministic same-player consecutive-row comparison emitted 5977 State-string changes across 105 distinct ordered pairs.

chain_edges.from: consecutive sampled tick_trace rows for one stable player_slot with differing State strings

evidence.locator: canonical/witnesses/CAP-R6-001/tick_state_edges.index.json; each occurrence stores player_slot plus before/after raw line, tick and seq locators

limits: This fact proves only recorded State-string changes at the tick_trace sampling boundary.
It does not assign gameplay meaning to any State string.
It does not prove DLL control flow, animation-bank meaning, timing meaning, root/facing ownership, choreography, damage causality, or aftermath semantics.
